population.span: we randomly assigned 2737 patients with New York Heart Association class II heart failure and an ejection fraction of no more than 35%

endpoint.span: RESULT OUTCOME 3 [SECONDARY]: Number of Participants With First Occurrence of All-Cause Mortality (Adjudicated) | DESCRIPTION: Death due to any cause.

estimate.span: RESULT OUTCOME 3 MEASUREMENT Up to 59.5 months (complete DB) (n= 1367, 1376): Eplerenone: Double-blind Phase=205; Placebo: Double-blind Phase=253

analysis_set.span: FAS using ITT principle: All randomized participants, followed for mortality and other major endpoints for the duration of the double blind treatment period, regardless of compliance with the study drug and the protocol.

treatment_strategy.span: to receive eplerenone (up to 50 mg daily) or placebo, in addition to recommended therapy.

follow_up.span: RESULT OUTCOME 3 MEASUREMENT Up to 59.5 months (complete DB) (n= 1367, 1376): Eplerenone: Double-blind Phase=205; Placebo: Double-blind Phase=253

absent_reason.ci: No confidence interval is explicitly tied to the complete double-blind follow-up counts at 59.5 months. The registry lists two timepoints and one HR analysis without identifying its timepoint.

served_mismatch: The served HR 0.76 (95% CI 0.62 to 0.93) matches the abstract's all-cause mortality result at premature stopping after median follow-up of 21 months. It does not establish the requested longest randomized follow-up: the registry reports later complete double-blind results through 59.5 months.

candidate_rejections.span: A total of 12.5% of patients receiving eplerenone and 15.5% of those receiving placebo died (hazard ratio, 0.76; 95% CI, 0.62 to 0.93; P=0.008)
candidate_rejections.why: Correct endpoint, but the abstract's premature-stopping result does not represent the later complete double-blind follow-up held in the registry.

candidate_rejections.span: RESULT OUTCOME 3 ANALYSIS 0: groups Eplerenone: Double-blind Phase, Placebo: Double-blind Phase | Hazard Ratio (HR) 0.761 (95% CI 0.622 to 0.932)
candidate_rejections.why: The outcome includes both cutoff and complete double-blind measurements; this analysis does not explicitly identify which timepoint it represents, so its CI cannot be assigned to the later counts.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The randomized population had NYHA class II heart failure and ejection fraction no greater than 35%; registry eligibility specifies minimum age 55 years.
entry_population_matches_question.span: we randomly assigned 2737 patients with New York Heart Association class II heart failure and an ejection fraction of no more than 35%

notes: Registry spans support the longest-follow-up counts, endpoint and ITT analysis population. OTHER denotes absence of a CI explicitly attributable to that timepoint; no interval was calculated or inferred. The analysis-set wording is repeated across registry outcomes, including outcome 3.
